title: A recursion tree for merge sort
description: A structural split tree for an input of size eight.
assumptions: The drawing shows subproblem sizes, not measured execution times.
Children are listed in left-to-right order; this is not a search tree.

diagrams.caption: At each shown level, the subproblem sizes sum to eight. The omitted size-one level completes the recursion; this is a supplied trace rather than executed code.
